Area.evidence_source: As shown in Table 1, the majority of the patients had diagnoses of the schizophrenia spectrum and major depression. Only a small number of individuals were diagnosed with bipolar disorder and personality disorder. The majority of the patients had a history of nonadherence to treatment and multiple hospitalizations.
